property_summary: For any target address and amount the reference contract's sendMoney either reverts on a failing external call (so the call does not silently succeed) — i.e. calling sendMoney to a callee that always reverts will cause the call to revert — while the mutant that drops the require will not revert and will appear to succeed for some inputs (the failing callee), violating this rule.
change_summary: Replace the call that requires success with a call that ignores the returned success flag (no require), allowing sendMoney to succeed even if the external call failed, changing observable state by not reverting on failure.
